title: Esports DB
description: PandaScore esports data - matches, teams, players, tournaments, leagues.

game_overview.title: Game Coverage Overview
game_overview.description: How many leagues, series and tournaments does each game have? A quick snapshot of coverage across all titles.
game_overview.sql: SELECT v.name AS game, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leagues WHERE videogame_id = v.id) AS leagues, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series WHERE videogame_id = v.id) AS series, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournaments WHERE videogame_id = v.id) AS tournaments FROM videogames v ORDER BY leagues DESC

leagues_by_game.title: Leagues for a Game
leagues_by_game.description: Browse up to 100 leagues across all games or filter by game. Results are ordered by series count; enter a game name such as Counter-Strike, Valorant, Dota 2, or LoL.
leagues_by_game.sql: SELECT v.name AS game, l.name AS league, l.url, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS series_count FROM leagues l JOIN videogames v ON v.id = l.videogame_id LEFT JOIN series s ON s.league_id = l.id WHERE v.name LIKE '%' || :game || '%' GROUP BY l.id ORDER BY series_count DESC LIMIT 100

coverage_by_year.title: Historical Coverage by Year
coverage_by_year.description: How many tournaments were recorded per game per year? All filters are optional. Leave blank to see everything.
coverage_by_year.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', t.begin_at) AS year, v.name AS game, COUNT(*) AS tournaments FROM tournaments t JOIN videogames v ON v.id = t.videogame_id WHERE t.begin_at IS NOT NULL AND (:game = '' OR v.name LIKE '%' || :game || '%') AND (:year = '' OR strftime('%Y', t.begin_at) = :year) GROUP BY year, v.id ORDER BY year DESC, tournaments DESC

major_events.title: Major Events (S-Tier)
major_events.description: The most prestigious events in esports - Majors, Worlds, Grand Finals. Leave Game blank for all titles.
major_events.sql: SELECT v.name AS game, l.name AS league, s.full_name AS series, t.name AS tournament, t.tier, t.prizepool, t.begin_at, t.end_at, CASE t.winner_type WHEN 'Team' THEN (SELECT name FROM teams WHERE id = t.winner_id) ELSE NULL END AS winner FROM tournaments t JOIN videogames v ON v.id = t.videogame_id JOIN leagues l ON l.id = t.league_id LEFT JOIN series s ON s.id = t.serie_id WHERE t.tier = 's' AND (:game = '' OR v.name LIKE '%' || :game || '%') ORDER BY t.begin_at DESC LIMIT 100

ongoing_tournaments.title: Ongoing Tournaments
ongoing_tournaments.description: Tournaments whose start and end dates indicate they are in progress; this is separate from whether any match is live. Events without an end date remain eligible. Filter by Game or Tier; leave either blank to include all values.
ongoing_tournaments.sql: SELECT v.name AS game, l.name AS league, s.full_name AS series, t.name AS tournament, t.tier, t.prizepool, t.begin_at, t.end_at FROM tournaments t JOIN videogames v ON v.id = t.videogame_id JOIN leagues l ON l.id = t.league_id LEFT JOIN series s ON s.id = t.serie_id WHERE t.begin_at <= datetime('now') AND (t.end_at IS NULL OR t.end_at >= datetime('now')) AND (:game = '' OR v.name LIKE '%' || :game || '%') AND (:tier = '' OR t.tier = :tier) ORDER BY t.tier, (t.begin_at IS NULL), t.begin_at ASC LIMIT 50

upcoming_tournaments.title: Upcoming Tournaments
upcoming_tournaments.description: Find tournaments whose start date is in the future, soonest first. Filter by Game or Tier; leave either blank to include all values.
upcoming_tournaments.sql: SELECT v.name AS game, l.name AS league, s.full_name AS series, t.name AS tournament, t.tier, t.prizepool, t.begin_at, t.end_at FROM tournaments t JOIN videogames v ON v.id = t.videogame_id JOIN leagues l ON l.id = t.league_id LEFT JOIN series s ON s.id = t.serie_id WHERE t.begin_at > datetime('now') AND (:game = '' OR v.name LIKE '%' || :game || '%') AND (:tier = '' OR t.tier = :tier) ORDER BY t.begin_at ASC LIMIT 100

completed_tournaments.title: Completed Tournaments
completed_tournaments.description: Review recently completed events, with winner when available. Filter by Game or Tier; leave either blank to include all values.
completed_tournaments.sql: SELECT v.name AS game, l.name AS league, s.full_name AS series, t.name AS tournament, t.tier, t.prizepool, t.begin_at, t.end_at, CASE t.winner_type WHEN 'Team' THEN (SELECT name FROM teams WHERE id = t.winner_id) ELSE NULL END AS winner FROM tournaments t JOIN videogames v ON v.id = t.videogame_id JOIN leagues l ON l.id = t.league_id LEFT JOIN series s ON s.id = t.serie_id WHERE t.end_at < datetime('now') AND t.end_at IS NOT NULL AND (:game = '' OR v.name LIKE '%' || :game || '%') AND (:tier = '' OR t.tier = :tier) ORDER BY t.end_at DESC LIMIT 50

live_matches.title: Live Matches
live_matches.description: Matches whose status is marked running, with participants and the main official stream embed when available. This is different from a tournament being ongoing based on its dates. Filter by Game, Tier, or part of a Tournament name; leave any blank to skip that filter. Results are capped at 100.
live_matches.sql: WITH selected_matches AS (SELECT m.id FROM matches m JOIN videogames v ON v.id = m.videogame_id JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id WHERE m.status = 'running' AND (:game = '' OR v.name LIKE '%' || :game || '%') AND (:tier = '' OR t.tier = :tier) AND (:tournament = '' OR t.name LIKE '%' || :tournament || '%') ORDER BY (m.begin_at IS NULL), m.begin_at ASC LIMIT 100) SELECT v.name AS game, l.name AS league, s.full_name AS series, t.name AS tournament, m.id AS match_id, m.name AS match_name, m.status, m.begin_at, t.tier, m.match_type, m.number_of_games, COALESCE(tm1.name, p1.name) AS team_1, mo1.score AS score_1, mo1.is_winner AS team_1_won, COALESCE(tm2.name, p2.name) AS team_2, mo2.score AS score_2, mo2.is_winner AS team_2_won, m.live_embed_url FROM selected_matches selected JOIN matches m ON m.id = selected.id JOIN videogames v ON v.id = m.videogame_id JOIN leagues l ON l.id = m.league_id JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id LEFT JOIN series s ON s.id = m.serie_id LEFT JOIN match_opponents mo1 ON mo1.match_id = m.id AND mo1.id = (SELECT MIN(x.id) FROM match_opponents x WHERE x.match_id = m.id) LEFT JOIN teams tm1 ON mo1.opponent_id = tm1.id AND mo1.opponent_type = 'Team' COLLATE NOCASE LEFT JOIN players p1 ON mo1.opponent_id = p1.id AND mo1.opponent_type = 'Player' COLLATE NOCASE LEFT JOIN match_opponents mo2 ON mo2.match_id = m.id AND mo2.id = (SELECT MIN(x.id) FROM match_opponents x WHERE x.match_id = m.id AND x.id > mo1.id) LEFT JOIN teams tm2 ON mo2.opponent_id = tm2.id AND mo2.opponent_type = 'Team' COLLATE NOCASE LEFT JOIN players p2 ON mo2.opponent_id = p2.id AND mo2.opponent_type = 'Player' COLLATE NOCASE ORDER BY (m.begin_at IS NULL), m.begin_at ASC

upcoming_matches.title: Upcoming Matches
upcoming_matches.description: Find scheduled matches not yet started, soonest first, with competition and participants. Filter by Game, Tier, or part of a Tournament name; leave any blank to skip that filter. Results are capped at 100.
upcoming_matches.sql: WITH selected_matches AS (SELECT m.id FROM matches m JOIN videogames v ON v.id = m.videogame_id JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id WHERE m.status = 'not_started' AND (:game = '' OR v.name LIKE '%' || :game || '%') AND (:tier = '' OR t.tier = :tier) AND (:tournament = '' OR t.name LIKE '%' || :tournament || '%') ORDER BY (m.scheduled_at IS NULL), m.scheduled_at ASC LIMIT 100) SELECT v.name AS game, l.name AS league, s.full_name AS series, t.name AS tournament, m.id AS match_id, m.name AS match_name, m.status, m.scheduled_at, m.rescheduled, t.tier, m.match_type, m.number_of_games, COALESCE(tm1.name, p1.name) AS team_1, COALESCE(tm2.name, p2.name) AS team_2 FROM selected_matches selected JOIN matches m ON m.id = selected.id JOIN videogames v ON v.id = m.videogame_id JOIN leagues l ON l.id = m.league_id JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id LEFT JOIN series s ON s.id = m.serie_id LEFT JOIN match_opponents mo1 ON mo1.match_id = m.id AND mo1.id = (SELECT MIN(x.id) FROM match_opponents x WHERE x.match_id = m.id) LEFT JOIN teams tm1 ON mo1.opponent_id = tm1.id AND mo1.opponent_type = 'Team' COLLATE NOCASE LEFT JOIN players p1 ON mo1.opponent_id = p1.id AND mo1.opponent_type = 'Player' COLLATE NOCASE LEFT JOIN match_opponents mo2 ON mo2.match_id = m.id AND mo2.id = (SELECT MIN(x.id) FROM match_opponents x WHERE x.match_id = m.id AND x.id > mo1.id) LEFT JOIN teams tm2 ON mo2.opponent_id = tm2.id AND mo2.opponent_type = 'Team' COLLATE NOCASE LEFT JOIN players p2 ON mo2.opponent_id = p2.id AND mo2.opponent_type = 'Player' COLLATE NOCASE ORDER BY (m.scheduled_at IS NULL), m.scheduled_at ASC

completed_matches.title: Completed Matches
completed_matches.description: Review recent finished match scores and participants. Filter by Game, Tier, or part of a Tournament name; leave any blank to skip that filter. Results are capped at 100.
completed_matches.sql: WITH selected_matches AS (SELECT m.id FROM matches m JOIN videogames v ON v.id = m.videogame_id JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id WHERE m.status = 'finished' AND (:game = '' OR v.name LIKE '%' || :game || '%') AND (:tier = '' OR t.tier = :tier) AND (:tournament = '' OR t.name LIKE '%' || :tournament || '%') ORDER BY (m.end_at IS NULL), m.end_at DESC LIMIT 100) SELECT v.name AS game, l.name AS league, s.full_name AS series, t.name AS tournament, m.id AS match_id, m.name AS match_name, m.end_at, t.tier, m.match_type, m.forfeit, COALESCE(tm1.name, p1.name) AS team_1, mo1.score AS score_1, COALESCE(tm2.name, p2.name) AS team_2, mo2.score AS score_2 FROM selected_matches selected JOIN matches m ON m.id = selected.id JOIN videogames v ON v.id = m.videogame_id JOIN leagues l ON l.id = m.league_id JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id LEFT JOIN series s ON s.id = m.serie_id LEFT JOIN match_opponents mo1 ON mo1.match_id = m.id AND mo1.id = (SELECT MIN(x.id) FROM match_opponents x WHERE x.match_id = m.id) LEFT JOIN teams tm1 ON mo1.opponent_id = tm1.id AND mo1.opponent_type = 'Team' COLLATE NOCASE LEFT JOIN players p1 ON mo1.opponent_id = p1.id AND mo1.opponent_type = 'Player' COLLATE NOCASE LEFT JOIN match_opponents mo2 ON mo2.match_id = m.id AND mo2.id = (SELECT MIN(x.id) FROM match_opponents x WHERE x.match_id = m.id AND x.id > mo1.id) LEFT JOIN teams tm2 ON mo2.opponent_id = tm2.id AND mo2.opponent_type = 'Team' COLLATE NOCASE LEFT JOIN players p2 ON mo2.opponent_id = p2.id AND mo2.opponent_type = 'Player' COLLATE NOCASE ORDER BY (m.end_at IS NULL), m.end_at DESC

team_roster.title: Team Roster
team_roster.description: Browse up to 100 active players across all games or filter by Game and/or full or partial Team name. Leave either filter blank to broaden the results.
team_roster.sql: SELECT te.name AS team, te.acronym, v.name AS game, p.name AS player, p.first_name, p.last_name, p.role, p.nationality, p.active FROM players p JOIN teams te ON te.id = p.current_team_id LEFT JOIN videogames v ON v.id = p.current_videogame_id WHERE p.active = 1 AND (:game = '' OR v.name LIKE '%' || :game || '%') AND (:team = '' OR te.name LIKE '%' || :team || '%') ORDER BY p.role, p.name LIMIT 100

team_schedule.title: Team Schedule & Results
team_schedule.description: Review up to 100 recent and upcoming matches across all teams or filter by Game and/or full or partial Team name. Leave either filter blank to broaden the results.
team_schedule.sql: WITH target_teams AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM teams WHERE (:team = '' OR name LIKE '%' || :team || '%') AND (:game = '' OR current_videogame_id IN (SELECT id FROM videogames WHERE name LIKE '%' || :game || '%'))), target_matches AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT mo.match_id FROM target_teams tt JOIN match_opponents mo ON mo.opponent_type = 'Team' COLLATE NOCASE AND mo.opponent_id = tt.id), recent_matches AS (SELECT m.id, CASE m.status WHEN 'finished' THEN m.end_at WHEN 'running' THEN m.begin_at ELSE m.scheduled_at END AS match_time FROM target_matches tm JOIN matches m ON m.id = tm.match_id ORDER BY (match_time IS NULL), match_time DESC LIMIT 100) SELECT v.name AS game, l.name AS league, s.full_name AS series, t.name AS tournament, m.id AS match_id, m.scheduled_at, m.begin_at, m.end_at, m.status, t.tier, m.match_type, m.number_of_games, COALESCE(tm1.name, p1.name) AS team_1, mo1.score AS score_1, COALESCE(tm2.name, p2.name) AS team_2, mo2.score AS score_2 FROM recent_matches rm JOIN matches m ON m.id = rm.id JOIN videogames v ON v.id = m.videogame_id JOIN leagues l ON l.id = m.league_id JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id LEFT JOIN series s ON s.id = m.serie_id LEFT JOIN match_opponents mo1 ON mo1.match_id = m.id AND mo1.id = (SELECT MIN(x.id) FROM match_opponents x WHERE x.match_id = m.id) LEFT JOIN teams tm1 ON mo1.opponent_id = tm1.id AND mo1.opponent_type = 'Team' COLLATE NOCASE LEFT JOIN players p1 ON mo1.opponent_id = p1.id AND mo1.opponent_type = 'Player' COLLATE NOCASE LEFT JOIN match_opponents mo2 ON mo2.match_id = m.id AND mo2.id = (SELECT MIN(x.id) FROM match_opponents x WHERE x.match_id = m.id AND x.id > mo1.id) LEFT JOIN teams tm2 ON mo2.opponent_id = tm2.id AND mo2.opponent_type = 'Team' COLLATE NOCASE LEFT JOIN players p2 ON mo2.opponent_id = p2.id AND mo2.opponent_type = 'Player' COLLATE NOCASE ORDER BY (rm.match_time IS NULL), rm.match_time DESC

videogames.description: Games covered in the database (Counter-Strike, Valorant, Dota 2, etc.)

series.description: Competitive seasons (series) within leagues, grouped by year

tournaments.description: Individual tournaments within series, with tier and prize pool information

players.description: Professional players with nationality, role, and active status

match_opponents.description: Teams or players participating in a match, with scores and win/loss result
